items.title: Agentic Treasury: How AI Agents Turn Cash Blind Spots Into Real-Time, Governed Action
items.summary: At 8 a.m., a $4 million payroll is due, but an expected customer payment hasn’t arrived. Leafy International’s treasury agent spots the gap in live payment data. It checks current balances and recommends a cash sweep from an overnight deposit. It’s enough to fund payroll while keeping Leafy’s $1 million minimum cash buffer intact.

items.summary: Real-time analytics on live operational data, built so applications and AI agents can act on what’s happening now.

items.title: Build Once, Grow Freely: Search and Vector Search on Atlas Infinite
items.summary: Enterprise workloads are getting bigger, more variable, and harder to predict, especially as agentic applications introduce spiky, unpredictable demand. Most data platforms weren't built for this reality—to cope with demand, they bolt AI services onto aging architecture, leaving customers to manage, monitor, and pay for multiple systems to get the job done. That fragmentation slows your teams down and limits how fast and how far your agentic applications can run.
